name: GetContact
label: Get Salesforce Contact
description: Retrieves a single Contact record from Salesforce by its ID.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to retrieve (required).

fields.name: ContactData
fields.label: Contact Data
fields.description: The retrieved Contact data as a JSON string.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
